Post 1
ASX closed at 8,502 pts last week as US election clarity faded into rate uncertainty. The real question: can materials hold the line if China stimulus disappointment returns? Cautiously bullish, but 8,500 is the level to defend. #ASX #ausbiz #macro

Post 2
🏦 Banks face margin squeeze scrutiny ahead of earnings updates — watch net interest margin guidance closely. ⛏️ Mining hinges on iron ore, last seen near USD 98/t, with China demand data the swing factor this week. #ASX #banking #ironore #mining

Post 3
🔺 Keep BHP on the radar — as the ASX's largest stock by weight, any move in iron ore toward USD 100/t rerates the index. BHP's China exposure makes it the single best proxy for risk appetite this week. #ASX #mining #BHP #ironore

Post 4
S&P 500 closed near 5,995 pts last week. If US CPI data this week prints above 2.6% yr/yr, rate cut expectations for December get repriced fast — and that hits ASX growth and property names hardest. #ASX #ausbiz #Fed #inflation #SP500

Post 5
US CPI drops Thursday AEDT — market pricing roughly 60% odds of a Fed cut in December. A hot print kills that trade; a soft one extends the rally. ASX rate-sensitives move either way. Which side are you on — cut or hold? #ASX #ausbiz #Fed #inflation #RBA
